item.title: Chesapeake Fire Department battles blaze on Shillelagh Road
item.description: The Chesapeake Fire Department responded to a fire in the 800 block of Shillelagh Road on Wednesday afternoon, extinguishing a 10-by-20-foot shed and a 40-by-30-foot detached two-car garage, with no injuries reported and the cause of the fire still under investigation.
